args.title: Retail Returns Logistics - Summary (2026)
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost driver in retail.
- Consolidated return hubs reduced handling costs by roughly a fifth (20%), showing clear efficiency gains from centralization.
- Companion piece finding: reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the original margin, underscoring the importance of speed in the returns-to-resale pipeline.
